    Buying veneers in Kakinada

    Veneer
    questions.

    For homeowners, carpenters, interior designers, architects and builders. Still unsure? Call or WhatsApp us and we will help you choose.

    What is wood veneer?
    Wood veneer is a thin slice of natural timber, fixed over a board such as plywood. It gives furniture, doors and wall panels the look of real wood, and every sheet has its own grain.
    Should I choose veneer or laminate?
    Choose veneer for the genuine look and warmth of real wood, polished to the shade you want. Choose laminate for a hard-wearing, easy-clean surface on kitchens, wardrobes and office furniture.
    Can I see the veneers before I buy?
    Yes. Grains and shades vary from sheet to sheet, so visit our Temple Street store to choose in person, or ask us on WhatsApp.
    Do your veneers come with a warranty?
    Yes. Liveteck veneers come with a lifetime warranty. Ask our team for the warranty details when you buy.
    How do I get veneer prices?
    Prices depend on the veneer and the quantity. Send us your list on WhatsApp (+91 99121 53030) and we will reply with prices and availability.
    Where is your shop in Kakinada?
    We are on Temple Street, beside Pydha Kalyana Mandapam, Kakinada, Andhra Pradesh. Visit us to see and compare before you buy, or call / WhatsApp +91 99121 53030.
